items.text: Bouncer on off, Hope backs away and tries to pull but ducks out of the way
items.shortText: Prince Yadav to Andrew, no run

items.text: Low full toss going down leg, he backs away and looks to flick but misses
Full on leg, arm ball, blocked back to the bowler

Oh, looked plumb and the finger goes up immediately! But Jewel Andrew has appealed. This is an arm ball on a length outside off, Andrew looks to reverse-sweep but misses the ball and is hit on his right pad around the knee-roll. No bat, and ball-tracking shows the ball crashing into leg stump. Axar gets the breakthrough two balls into his spell and Jewel Andrew's cameo at the top has come to an end

dismissal.text: J Andrew lbw b Patel 21 (23m 16b 2x4 1x6) SR: 131.25

items.text: Length ball angled across, he rocks back and pulls it out wide of long-on
On a length outside off, clipped to mid-on
Into the crowd! Tossed up full outside off, Hope clears his front leg and muscles it away over cow corner
Arm ball on a length outside off, clipped wide of mid-on for a single
items.postText: Yuvraj Singh to make his coaching debut. Details here.

items.text: Short and wide, he has a swipe but it's too wide
Yorker outside off, squeezed out to extra cover
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Hope, no run

items.text: Low full toss outside off, driven straight of cover, but the fielder puts in a good dive to stop it
Hetmyer takes on the short ball angled across him, looking to hook and manages to help it fine of the wicketkeeper and it trickles away
Low full toss on off, Hetmyer miscues it as he tries to whip it away, but manages to get it over the midwicket fielder
Full and wide, beyond the line
Inside edge and more runs for West Indies! Very full outside leg and Hetmyer tries to flick. The inside edge sends it racing fine on the leg side
Hetmyer in the zone! Arshdeep changes angles but ends up bowling it in the slot around leg and Hetmyer is able to loft it down the ground! West Indies finish the powerplay on 79 for 1!
items.postText: We have The Don in today's MATCHUP. Who can you connect him with?

items.text: Tossed up full outside off, driven out through point
On a length on middle and leg, tucked through midwicket
Arm ball on a length outside off, squeed to the off side for a single

In the gap and it beats the deep fielder! This is full on leg and Hetmyer slog-sweeps it in front of square. The ball just bounces short of the boundary rope and goes over as deep square leg raced across
Was that a chance? On a length on leg and it balloons to Samson's right off Hetmyer's pad. Samson tries to chase and dives, but the ball eludes his gloves. Was there an inside edge onto the pads?
Flung full and wide and Hetmyer creams a drive through the covers

Hope has no time for the part-timer! This is tossed up full around middle and off and Hope slog-sweeps it high and in between deep midwicket and long-on. The two fielders converge, but can only watch it sail over
On a length outside off, Hope gets across and tucks it out to deep midwicket
Tossed up quite wide outside off, Hetmyer reaches out and slaps it out to the off-side sweeper
